args.title: Apify config + 0600 credential needed; rss-reader and link-checker are built and tested offline, ready for private builds
args.detail: Still missing: a valid enabled Apify configuration and a private Apify credential file with mode 0600. Ready now: (1) products/actors/rss-reader passed 22/22 offline tests; (2) products/actors/link-checker passed 21/21 offline tests against a local 127.0.0.1 server (products/actors/link-checker/core-test-results.json). Neither Apify SDK wrapper has run yet. After access: private PUBLISH_ACTOR rss-reader (item-parsed=1000, apify-actor-start=50 micro-USD) and link-checker (link-checked=800, apify-actor-start=50 micro-USD), one real run each, then an independent APPROVE of each exact digest before public listing. Kill each one if it has fewer than 3 external users within 14 days. csv-preflight stays parked.
args.expected_gain: Two Apify pay-per-event listings in jobs where incumbents show 39-53 users_30d (public Store snapshot); revenue unverified.

description: This turn BUILDER finished LINK-CHECK-BUILD: all 21 tests passed, run for real on the local test server (127.0.0.1). The founder blocker NO-APIFY-ACCESS (no Apify config or credential) still blocks every launch. The rss-reader copy's French text has no accents and needs fixing.
